text:
kevin: quick check — I'm planning a staggered merge today to land the auth header change. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/981 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/483. SDK needs a small client bump after api change. Can folks review/approve so we can sequence?

rachel: on it, I'll take the SDK PR. tagging @sam for console/backfill needs — console will need the new header handling and a fallback for old clients.

sam: saw the API diff, looks fine. console PR will be ready once backend merges. I'll open the console PR draft now and mark it WIP.

maya: FYI helm/runtime: we need to publish a runtime-compatible image tag after api change. helm chart values need image.tag bump and a config toggle for the legacy header flag (defaults false). I'll prep the chart PR but will hold merge until SDK+console are green.

kevin: proposed merge order: 1) api (981) -> 2) sdk (483) -> 3) console (draft) -> 4) helm chart + runtime image tag. This keeps public API stable and lets SDK/console opt-in. Thoughts?

ash: sounds good. A couple tiny asks on the SDK PR: add a small migration note in CHANGELOG and a compatibility test in ci that hits both header formats. I'll approve after that.

rachel: will add CHANGELOG entry today. For CI: adding a matrix entry is fine but won't block merge if we add a short smoke test in the PR.

sam: console will implement fallback: check for X-User-Id v2 else try legacy header. I'll include tests. We should also coordinate a canary route (region us-west) to flip traffic before global rollout.

maya: noted on canary. I'll set helm values: canary=true + image.tag=canary-1998 then we can flip after smoke run.

kevin: timeline: plan to merge API at 12:30pm UTC, SDK at 1:00pm if green, console at 1:30pm, helm/runtime at 2:00pm. If anyone can't make those windows ping here ASAP.

rachel: 1pm UTC works for me for SDK review/merge.

ash: will aim to finish SDK review before 12:45.

sam: console draft opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/202 (WIP). I'll request reviews from @rachel and @maya when ready.

kevin: deploy-bot will run necessary smoke checks after each merge. deploy-bot: please post pass/fail in thread.

deploy-bot: CI started for api#981, status: running.

kevin: reminder — leave PRs unmerged until CI + canary smoke pass. If anything flakes, we pause sequence and roll back.

rachel: added changelog + simple compatibility test to SDK PR. PTAL @ash @nash.

ash: review complete, left one comment about log wording. Approving after fix.

sam: console WIP updated, adding fallback tests. Will ping for final review at ~1:15pm UTC.

maya: helm chart PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/77. Image built as canary-1998 and uploaded. Awaiting merge signal.

kevin: great. I'll start with API merge at 12:30. If deploy-bot reports any failures we stop. Otherwise follow the sequence. Thanks everyone — short window so please keep reviews tight. :thumbsup:
